changelog:
### New Features
- Export / Import User Data: full JSON backup & restore (users, subs, payments, API keys, addresses, blocked IPs, plans)
- Password Generator in Admin Edit User modal (crypto-secure, strength meter, show/hide, clipboard copy)
- Password Generator on User Dashboard Security tab (fills both New Password & Confirm Password)
- Full Admin Users & Subscriptions page: user list, tab filters, Edit User modal (profile, plan, security)
- Import merge mode: existing users updated, new users created; user IDs remapped automatically

### Bug Fixes
- Admin modal password generator not firing (stopPropagation blocked document listeners — moved to jQuery modal delegation)
- Import dropzone click not opening file picker (replaced display:none trigger with opacity:0 overlay)
- Import button not working after drag-and-drop (dragged file never assigned to fileInput.files — fixed with selectedFile variable)
- All Users tab not showing on page load (added display:block + JS init)
- Password generator modal UI not resetting on re-open
